description: This PHP source file defines a class `perf_mssqlnative` for performance monitoring and tuning of Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) databases within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It includes SQL statements, configuration settings, and methods for performing explain plans, retrieving table information, and health checks, tailored specifically for MSSQL using native functionalities.

classes.name: perf_mssqlnative
classes.description: A class extending adodb_perf to provide performance monitoring, SQL statement explanations, and database health checks specifically for MSSQL databases, including configuration of performance metrics and SQL execution methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with a database connection, configuring SQL syntax based on the data provider.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates and returns an execution plan explanation for a given SQL query, with optional partial matching.

methods.name: Tables
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs an HTML table listing database table names and sizes.

methods.name: sp_who
methods.description: Executes the 'sp_who' stored procedure to retrieve current database connections and returns their count.

methods.name: HealthCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check on the MSSQL database server, enabling and disabling trace flags around the check, and returns an HTML report.
